pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Why Rally gives one to a shelter for every item bought, and the rescue partners we work with across the country.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-col gap-6

children: Rally started with a shelter visit and a simple, uncomfortable thought: the aisle of a pet shop is full of good things, and a few miles away a room full of dogs and cats has almost none. So we built a pet brand around closing that gap — make the products people already want to buy, and give one away for every one we sell.

The giveback is not a marketing add-on we bolt onto a sale. It is the reason the company exists, and it is baked into the price of everything on the site. Buy a bed, and a shelter dog gets a bed. Buy a bag of treats, and a rescue cat eats. There is no round-up box to tick and no upsell — the good is already done by the time your order ships.

We are a small team of people who could not walk past. We make gear we would put our own animals on — durable, washable, honestly made — and we partner with shelters and rescues across the country to get the matched half where it is needed most. Every wag, on both ends, does some good.
